h87b_card.hypothesis: Unit-consistent Miller-Singh/Salem magnetic tilt-depth contacts, upward-continued TMI demagnetization, Gallardo-Meju cross-gradients, fluid-driven swarm seismicity excess (Kreemer-Young deq vs ieq), 2-m temperature probe F2mDAB & quartz enthalpy anomalies, and cross-sensor 1m LiDAR / 10m chi-knickpoint scarps — trained under within-fold counterfactual exposure debiasing across a multi-scale regularized histogram-boosted + smooth linear-logit ensemble with 300 m expected-credit non-redundant disc allocation — recover blind intrabasin, piedmont, and relay faults missed by exposed-scarp baselines.
h87b_card.mechanism: 1) Resolves IR87-028 (Band 6 verified at r=+0.997140 as GeoDAWN Radiometric Total Count, reconstructing true atan2(100*B09, B03+1) magnetic tilt & |grad(tilt)| depth proxy), IR87-029 (B10/B16 modeled as log swarm excess), and IR87-030 (Session 1 swapped B02 iso_grav_anom and B19 tmi_rtp with B08 det_elev_slope). 2) Masks 8-connected visible components + regional sub-blocks strictly inside each training fold. 3) Convolves calibrated posteriors with the exact 300 m triangular kernel before r_min=2.83 px priority disc thinning.
h87b_card.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville pluvial shoreline scarps, lateral outflow thermal plumes in permeable alluvial fans, pre-Tertiary pluton intrusive contacts, and primary K/Th-enriched welded ash-flow tuffs.
